name: LinkRelation
description: A typed web link as described by RFC 8288 Web Linking, including IANA-registered link relation types and extension relations identified by URI.

rel.description: Link relation type. Either an IANA-registered relation name or an extension relation expressed as an absolute URI.

href.description: Target IRI of the link. May be a URI Template per RFC 6570 when 'templated' is true.

anchor.description: Optional anchor IRI overriding the context of the link.

type.description: Hint at the media type of the target resource.

hreflang.description: Language hint for the target resource.

media.description: Intended destination medium or media for the link target.

profile.description: URI identifying additional semantics applied to the target representation.

deprecation.description: URL providing deprecation information about this link relation.
